## Important info

To use this skin you need to own Prestige Star Guardian Syndra and use it in champ sellect.


## Description

**Author**: Suriin

**Skin**: Prestige Star Guardian Syndra

**Affects**: Champion model, textures, loading screen.

I, like most people, prefer the first version of the splash art, which was later changed and made the skin more bland. I made this edit to make it look more like that first splash. Changed the bodice, necklace, hair, skirt tails (?), skirt and the loading screen splash. For an in-depth look at the changes see the Gallery tab.
